Starlink Direct to Cell is now live in the Philippines. 🇵🇭

Standard LTE phones can now stay connected via satellite in areas without cellular coverage no extra hardware required.

A major milestone for connectivity across the Philippines' thousands of islands.

Grok 4.5 is launching publicly on July 9. 🤖

Following strong beta feedback, Elon Musk says the new model delivers faster performance, better efficiency, and lower costs than previous versions.

Another big step forward for xAI.




Elon Musk (@elonmusk)

Our internal assessment is that Grok 4.5 is roughly comparable to Opus 4.7, but much faster. The combination of capability, faster speed and lower cost is what makes it competitive. 

We are closing the loop on real-world usefulness, not benchmarks. Hardcore engineers at Tesla & SpaceX find Grok 4.5 genuinely useful, which is what actually matters.
